recipe.visualDefinition: A playful 1960s-style composition combining flat, thick-outline cartoon characters with a single grayscale photographic head, set against a two-tone minimalist landscape of sky blue and grass green.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of hand-drawn ink lines and a realistic halftone photograph
High-contrast primary and secondary colors against a bright blue field
Top-heavy typographic header balanced by character clusters in the lower two-thirds
coreInvariants: Thick, consistent black ink outlines on all illustrated elements
Grayscale photographic element for the central figure's head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Characters are distributed across the lower half; the central figure with the photo-head is slightly larger and acts as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated figure with the photographic head and blue suit.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red title at the top, moves down to the central photo-head, then follows the gaze and gestures of the surrounding characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample sky-blue space in the upper-middle section provides breathing room for the dense typography above.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with minimal tonal variation, creating a flat, graphic look.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy inline or outline effects on display text
Condensed vertical proportions for secondary headers
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title features a double-outline effect with a red fill and white/black borders
Secondary text uses a vibrant magenta sans-serif with rounded terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold slab serif for impact paired with a friendly, rounded sans-serif for readability.
graphicDevices: Halftone photographic texture on the face

preserve: Condensed yellow slab for top-most text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure of the main title.
Captures the soft, friendly feel of the magenta subtitle.
Approximates the condensed yellow text at the very top.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat 2D illustration in a 1960s comic style. The background is divided into a large sky-blue upper section and a thin lime-green lower section. Place several cartoon characters with thick black outlines and flat color fills across the green ground. The central character should be a seated man in a blue suit, but his head should be a realistic grayscale halftone photograph of a man with glasses and a mustache.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text: 1. A top row of condensed yellow slab-serif text. 2. A large central title in red slab-serif with a white and black double outline. 3. A subtitle in bold magenta rounded sans-serif centered below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the central head a grayscale photograph?
Are all characters outlined in thick black ink?
Is the background composed of two flat color blocks?
Does the main title have a double outline?
Is the color palette limited to high-saturation primaries/secondaries?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the photo-head is grayscale and contrasts with the colored body.
Verify the line weight is consistent across all illustrations.
Check that the typography does not overlap the characters.
Confirm the ground plane is a simple horizontal division.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Flat Cartoon Style] + [Grayscale Photomontage Head] + [Mid-Century Slab Serif Typography] + [Two-Tone Minimalist Landscape Background].
